Name: Meremoth, Priest of Jeshua's Days
Summary: Meremoth was a priestly course head in the days of Jeshua son of Jozadak. NOTE ON IDENTITY: a priest named Meremoth son of Uriah appears in Ezra and Nehemiah's wall and covenant lists; the text does not say whether the course head of Nehemiah 12:3 is that man, so this profile covers only the Nehemiah 12:3 course head and does not merge them.
LifeLesson: The courses of priests kept worship ordered across generations.
